subject: PROGRESS lowering-opus pass-MRT (one JM job per 2-attachment pass): code in, host units PASS, iOS syntax rc=0; CA/frame_bench runs blocked by tegu_air_render_pipeline_plan_generic_buffer_templates (encode-cpu's in-progress plan-memo export, Rust lib not rebuilt)
body: Pieces (all host-only, not device): (1) mali_graphics_compiler.c MULTI_TARGET+TILE_FETCH (fetch j = LD_TILE rt=j, FAU 48+8j) - private .so check PASS. (2) render_pipeline.inc fenced block 'lowering-opus: pass-MRT variant' (tegu_render_variant_pass_mrt: MULTI_TARGET over the pipeline's attachment formats, +TILE_FETCH when the FS declares subpass inputs, memory fetch / zero written mask refused -> caller keeps per-RT; own key 'TGPASSMRT1'+formats, standard publish protocol). (3) render_encoder.inc: a draw of a multi-attachment non-true-MRT, non-path pipeline in a pass whose bound targets match its formats, with PF=1 + JM batching + NORD2_METAL_PASS_MRT!=0 (default on), is lowered as a true-MRT job over all attachments (sidecar write masks = compiled written outputs, others 0; continuation loads; per-RT second job skipped); a refused variant falls back to the old path (TEGU_PASS_MRT trace lines). (4) bridge: MRT batches accept LD_TILE programs; n2r sets load_destination on every target for tile-fetch programs. Device-calibrated estimate (c6n ui654 60 Hz baseline 19.1 ms/cmd, 14.65 kj/cmd, 9.03 fs/cmd; BM1 11.8 ms at 8.49 kj -> ~1.19 ms per kernel job removed, ~1.7 ms fixed): pass-MRT turns the ~7.9 in-pass full-screen splits per cmd (memfetch ~4.1 + rt0/rt1 interleave ~4.0) into ~1.2 full-screen jobs (enc_fs 62/53 cmds) -> ~6.5 kj/cmd -> ~9-10 ms/cmd with cap 128 (range 8-12: pixel work per job grows, per-job fixed costs disappear). Next: CA host test + fsjobs census (C6F_ATTACHMENTS=2 real CA pipelines) once the tree links, then gates + stable.
